title: The Paired Hawk Body Course
summary: A school course in paired plunging blows and a hardened hide that closes on the descent of two hawks as one body.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Frame
summary: A school manual of the frame that sits in judgement under the azure sky and ends in a verdict of weight.

title: The Twin River Body Canon
summary: A school canon of two streams of strike and recovery that run through the body and meet in one great closing blow.

title: Treatise of the Hawk Dive and Armored Hide
summary: A school treatise joining the diving blow of the hawk with the unbreakable hide of the Azure Sky body.

title: Canon of the Hawk's Highest Body
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the body at its highest soar and its great falling blow.

title: The Wind-Sworn Body Course
summary: A school course of the wind-sworn body that leans on the wind and closes with the blow the wind itself delivers.

title: Manual of the Plateau Frame
summary: A school manual of the frame that holds its bearing on open ground and ends in a charge with the wind at its back.

title: The Oath of the Open Frame
summary: A school oath of the frame that takes no cover and fills itself with held qi until one open blow ends the exchange.

title: Treatise of the Bearing and the Long Wind
summary: A school treatise that joins a held bearing with the long wind so the frame never turns and always arrives.

title: Canon of the Oath Beyond the Wind
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the oath that outlasts the wind and the last blow sworn to it.
